_meta.name: Adolescent Major Depressive Episode, Past Year
_meta.source: SAMHSA, National Survey on Drug Use and Health
_meta.note: SAMHSA's National Survey on Drug Use and Health, adolescents aged 12–17. 2004–2019 from the 2019 detailed tables' trend Table 11.2B; 2021 onward from the 2022/2024/2025 detailed tables. There is NO 2020 value: the 2020 survey was disrupted by the pandemic and SAMHSA says it is not comparable, and the 2021 redesign (web mode, new questions, new weighting) started a new baseline — SAMHSA advises against comparing 2021+ with earlier years, so the 2020 gap is a seam, not a missing year. Where a later release revised a year (2024 appears in both the 2024 and 2025 tables) the newer release wins.
_meta.method: 2019 Table 11.2B (2004–2019), TOTAL row; 2022/2024/2025 Tables 7.21B/7.3B/7.3B, TOTAL row, first two percentage columns (Total for adults; Had MDE for adolescents), newer release wins
